statement: Organisations with a >= 1e26 FLOP run are headquartered in >= 4 jurisdictions (Epoch AI; snapshot 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: 0 jurisdictions at the timeline start (no organisation had a >= 1e26 FLOP run). The largest documented runs (~2.5e24 FLOP) belonged to Bloc A developers; Bloc B's largest open model at the time was a 130B-parameter bilingual model positioned as GPT-3-class, well below the frontier.

items.summary: The largest documented training run (~2.5e24 FLOP, 540B parameters, 6144 accelerator chips) was by a Bloc A developer; no organisation in any jurisdiction was near 1e26.
items.detail: Google Research blog, 'Pathways Language Model (PaLM): Scaling to 540 Billion Parameters', 2022-04-04 (verified via web_extract this run; 6144 TPU v4 chips, 'largest TPU-based system configuration used for training to date'). Compute figure 2.5e24 FLOP per Epoch AI model page (current database, opened this run; country listed as Bloc A) and Heim (2022-04-05).

items.summary: A Bloc B university lab released open weights for a 130B-parameter bilingual model, claimed to beat GPT-3 175B and the previous largest Bloc B language model (260B) on benchmarks; scale roughly an order of magnitude below the largest Bloc A run.
items.detail: Tsinghua University (THUDM), 'GLM-130B: An Open Bilingual Pre-trained Model', arXiv:2210.02414 v1 submitted 2022-10-05 (verified via web_extract this run; abstract cites ERNIE 3.0 Titan 260B as the largest Bloc B language model). Training compute not stated in the abstract; the order-of-magnitude comparison is an inference from parameter count and GPT-3-class positioning.
